description: This file contains functions and constants related to performing TLS and network preflight checks for OpenAI OAuth integration, including error handling, certificate path resolution, and user notifications.

methods.name: asRecord
methods.description: Converts an unknown value to a Record<string, unknown> or null.

methods.name: extractFailure
methods.description: Extracts failure details from an error object, determining if it's a TLS certificate error or network error.

methods.name: resolveHomebrewPrefixFromExecPath
methods.description: Resolves the Homebrew prefix path from the executable path.

methods.name: resolveCertBundlePath
methods.description: Constructs the path to the OpenSSL certificate bundle based on Homebrew prefix.

methods.name: hasOpenAICodexOAuthProfile
methods.description: Checks if the provided configuration has an OpenAI Codex OAuth profile.

methods.name: shouldRunOpenAIOAuthTlsPrerequisites
methods.description: Determines whether to run the OAuth TLS preflight checks based on configuration and parameters.
